## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Query the collected fee balance for the token before calling withdraw_treasury; request at most the available amount.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_withdraw_treasury(&f.governor, &f.token, &f.recipient, &1));
```
